title: What Photosynthetic Facades Is
definition: Photosynthetic Facades: facades generating energy like leaves.
description:
Photosynthetic Facades — Signature Edition: facades generating energy like leaves. This is the JAH-original vision, designed from first principles and labeled as Signature speculation throughout.

The Signature facade hulls program starts where public roadmaps stop. Where public research asks what is fundable, the Signature line asks what is buildable: algae panels rethought, facade logistics rebuilt, light capture reimagined for the century ahead. title: The Signature Vision: Photosynthetic Facades
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Photosynthetic Facades.
description:
The Signature vision of Photosynthetic Facades does not ask what committees will fund — it asks what physics allows and what engineering can compound.

Signature facade hulls program, charter one: master algae panels at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale facade logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate light capture systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Photosynthetic Facades becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

title: 2030 — First facade hulls districts certified: algae panels assembly at
definition: 2030 milestone on the Photosynthetic Facades roadmap.
description:
First facade hulls districts certified: algae panels assembly at half the time and carbon of legacy builds.

What must be true first: the algae panels results have to replicate outside the lab, facade logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and light capture operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed algae panels demonstrations, facade logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting light capture uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Photosynthetic Facades
definition: Estimates Photosynthetic Facades readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Photosynthetic Facades components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a facade hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Photosynthetic Facades Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Photosynthetic Facades operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Photosynthetic Facades installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 70760 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where algae panels monitoring, facade logistics redundancy, or light capture maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Photosynthetic Facades Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Photosynthetic Facades: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Photosynthetic Facades — facades generating energy like leaves.

Phase 1 — Prove (algae panels): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (facade logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (light capture): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (maintenance): facade hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and buildings-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
